summary: At step 50, self-zapping a wished wand of opening while engulfed by an air elemental reaches zap.c:zapyourself -> zap.c:release_hold -> mhitu.c:expels(TRUE). C emits ‘You get expelled from the air elemental!’ before unsticking and relocating the monster. JavaScript reaches js/zap.js:release_hold, records note_unported('mhitu.c expels TRUE'), and skips the shared transition; js/mhitu.js:expels also explicitly refuses its message=true arm. The recorded RNG matches through the whole session, while the final screen and cursor differ. The source correction is the full mhitu.c:expels function plus wiring every active JavaScript caller whose corresponding C call may pass TRUE.

source.branch: expels(mtmp, mdat, message): when message is TRUE choose regurgitation for digests(), an unfold-and-release line for enfolds(), or the engulf-attack-specific expulsion suffix; then always unstuck, mnexto(RLOC_NOMSG), redraw the hero square, emit the distant-landing line when um_dist exceeds one, and call spoteffects(TRUE).
callers: zap.c:release_hold (swallowed hero hit by WAN_OPENING/SPE_KNOCK or self-zap)
dog.c:tamedog (taming a monster currently engulfing the hero)
polyself.c:polymon (new player form cannot remain engulfed; message flag may be FALSE for unsolid form)
polyself.c:dospinweb (hero spins a web while swallowed by an animal)
wizard.c:tactics (covetous monster switches to STRAT_HEAL while swallowing the hero)
detect.c:openit (swallowed hero hit by opening magic)

evidence: The accepted v40 recording has 51 steps; the first mismatch is segment 0, step 50, on the final screen and cursor. Its last C message is ‘You get expelled from the air elemental!’; RNG is complete at 2158/2158.
The C route is cmd.c:rhack -> zap.c:dozap -> zap.c:zapyourself (WAN_OPENING) -> zap.c:release_hold -> mhitu.c:expels(TRUE). See upstream zap.c:2705-3013 and 578-611; mhitu.c:264-309.

js/zap.js:release_hold currently replaces the swallowed call with note_unported('mhitu.c expels TRUE'); js/mhitu.js:expels explicitly refuses rawEnv.expulsionMessage. The caller misses both the C message and the following shared relocation/redraw/spoteffects work.

The full direct C caller inventory has ten active TRUE-capable functions: zap.c:bhitm, zap.c:release_hold, dog.c:tamedog, monmove.c:release_hero, end.c:savelife, polyself.c:polymon, polyself.c:dospinweb, wizard.c:tactics, dig.c:zap_dig, and detect.c:openit. Existing JavaScript paths exist for all ten; each must invoke the canonical helper with its source message argument rather than retain the placeholder or duplicate message.

FALSE-only callers mhitu.c:gulpmu, mon.c:vamprises, mon.c:vamp_stone, and mon.c:newcham are already wired to js/mhitu.js:expels and will retain the false-message behavior. mon.c:xkilled uses spoteffects directly as a poor-man’s expels and is not a direct caller.
